integrity: The universal statement is supported by an explicit mathematical proof. Reproducible exhaustive computations for n=4,...,8 corroborate but do not replace the infinite argument. The known scalar minimum and cycle n=3 case are credited to prior work.
scientific_limitations: For standard power domination only on labeled crown graphs K_{n,n}-M_n for integers n>=4. Does not extend to partial matching deletions or generalized k-propagation. The 2019 paper k-Power Domination of Crown Graph could not be inspected in full and remains an originality/priority risk; independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: Complete power-domination census and irredundant spectrum of crown graphs
